paras: Acanthodactylus nilsoni, commonly called Nilson's spiny-toed lizard, is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is endemic to Iran.
The specific name, nilsoni, is in honor of Swedish herpetologist Göran Nilson (born 1948).
Acanthodactylus nilsoni is found in Kermanshah Province, western Iran.
The preferred natural habitats of Acanthodactylus nilsoni are grassland and shrubland, at elevations up to 285 m (935 ft).
Acanthodactylus nilsoni is medium-sized for its genus, with a maximum snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 7.4 cm (2.9 in), and a maximum tail length of 16.5 cm (6.5 in).
